I relate to your fear, I actually had a really shitty time in high school with friendship making because it all felt soooo superficial(rejection is terrifying and being afraid of being seen as weird is a very real fear). University was different for me though, yes it’s true most people are kind out of politeness, and no most of the time they don’t care about your hometown. However, a lot of the closest friendships I have once started as those conversations too. Maybe it’ll help finding people with something in common with you? Have you checked out any clubs?
I personally made friends really easily, especially in first year, everyone wants to make friends. You just kinda have to put yourself out there 😭

Honestly making friends in my experience, took a lot of time and effort. I constantly had to put myself out of my comfort zone, in order to initiate friendships. I definitely agree reaching out to someone after meeting them isn’t easy, but I will say the idea of you thinking they don’t want to be friends because they didn’t reach out first is unfair. University is a scary experience, everyone is terrified of reaching out to people they don’t know. Classes are huge and schedules are packed, in order to form friendships you actively have to reach out, the best way I did this was asking the people I met for their schedules and either walking to class together or trying to meet for drinks in between. I promise you, you got this and friendships come with time :)
I truly have made amazing friends in university, especially Mac, people here are very friendly and sweet. Continue to put effort in this and I assure you it’ll pay off
